items.title: Sharkey Bonano Interview, 1966-11-09
items.q: And Crum, I think it was something like that. I just can't remember.

ctx.x: Oh I have a note on the record, it was French, Barrowman French. That's his name, yeah.
And Crum, I think it was something like that. I just can't remember.

Yeah, a drummer, Alonzo Crumby. Alonzo Crumby, right. I was going to ask about Harry Shields. I never got to hear his brother, older brother. Do you think their styles are a good deal the same? I like Harry's playing very much and it sounds to me somewhat... The sounds are practically the same.
